title: Early Symptoms of Pregnancy: Signs, Timeline, When to Test and What to Do Next in India
seoTitle: Early Symptoms of Pregnancy: Signs, Timeline, Test
seoDescription: Early pregnancy signs: missed period, nausea, tiredness, sore breasts and frequent urination, usually from 4 to 6 weeks. When to test and what to do next.
excerpt: A rough timeline of when each sign tends to appear, the look-alikes that cause confusion, the right day to use a home test, the warning signs that need a hospital, and free government antenatal care in India.
